content: QED is now 0.902 and SA 1.958 - both ends of the pharmacophore are in place. One thing left. The fluorine at atom 18 on the central ring looks helpful and is not: measured on two matched pairs it costs 0.01-0.05 of activity, and although it is adding about 0.01 of QED here, that trade is clearly negative. Atom 17 is the aromatic carbon carrying it and the 17-18 bond is non-ring, so I remove it. The product is N-{4-[(4-methylpyridin-2-yl)amino]phenyl}cyclopropanecarboxamide at 253 Da: conjugated anilide N-H, para 4-methylpyridin-2-ylamino with the ring nitrogen ortho to a free N-H, monocyclic azine, cyclopropanecarboxamide cap, no deactivating halogen. This is the single best molecule I have found for this target, and getting it into the population now - rather than discovering it again - means the next two generations can start their refinement from it instead of from random ZINC.
